annotations.title: Which UK tourist tax applies at this postcode (live lookup)

description: UK only. Call this FIRST when you know the property's postcode: it looks the postcode up live (postcodes.io, Office for National Statistics open data) to find the council and nation, then says which tourist tax (visitor levy) applies there, from when, at what rate, whether the Wales visitor accommodation register applies, and the `area` value to pass to calculate_uk_tourist_tax. Example: {"postcode":"EH1 1YZ"}. Free.
name: which_tourist_tax_applies
